name: Simply Halls
shortDescription: A UK public-hall listing and booking platform for church halls, village halls and community venues, operated by GKR Solutions Limited.
suitableContexts: Churches listing a hall for community hire
Volunteer-run halls wanting a shared booking calendar and public discovery
Venues that want online booking and payout handling without a subscription fee

pricing.summary: Simply Halls says halls pay no subscription or commission and retain their hire fees. It says customers usually pay a £2.25 booking fee. Confirm the current customer fee, payment-provider terms, refunds and payout timing before relying on it for hall income.

tiers.label: Hall listing and booking management
tiers.detail: Shared calendar, online bookings, public listing, approval controls and automatic hall-owner payouts

tiers.label: Customer booking fee
tiers.detail: Supplier-stated fee paid by the customer when booking online

gdprInformation: Simply Halls says it acts as controller for booking, payment and account data and processor for hall owners. Its published policy covers data categories, retention, international-transfer safeguards and user rights. Obtain the current contract, payment-provider/sub-processor list, hosting location, incident terms, data export and deletion arrangements before uploading hirer data.
coreFeatures: Hall hire terms and cancellation-policy display
importExport: Supplier states it will upload existing bookings during setup
support: Supplier-led setup and training stated on its public site
Email and WhatsApp support contact published

uk-operator.value: Simply Halls identifies GKR Solutions Limited, company number 09934200, as its registered-address company.

church-hall-scope.value: Supplier publishes a free booking-management and promotion platform specifically for UK church halls, village halls and community venues.

fees.value: Supplier says hall owners pay no subscription or commission and customers usually pay a £2.25 booking fee.

data-processing.value: Supplier privacy policy states it acts as controller for bookings, payments and accounts, and processor for hall owners; it publishes six-year retention for booking and payment records.

editorial.assessment: Simply Halls combines public discovery with booking management for community and church halls. The supplier's no-subscription, no-commission model may suit a volunteer-run hall, but its customer booking fee, payment and payout model should be tested against the church's hire policy and financial controls. It is a public hire and promotion platform, not an internal church room scheduler or a replacement for a church database.
bestFor: Church halls wanting public discoverability as well as booking management
Volunteer teams seeking no subscription fee for the hall
Venues comfortable with customer-paid booking fees and online payout workflows
strengths: Named UK company and public registered address
No subscription or commission stated for hall owners
Published controller/processor distinction and retention statement
limitations: Customers usually pay a booking fee, which may not suit every church's hire policy
Confirm payment-provider, payout, refund and cancellation arrangements
Obtain current contract, sub-processor, hosting, incident, export and deletion documents
Not an internal ministry-room or church-management platform

procurementVerdict.problem: Reducing volunteer administration while making a church hall easier to find and book
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A UK hall-discovery and booking platform with no stated hall subscription or commission
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Create a test listing and model a real booking, cancellation, refund and payout before publishing the church hall to the platform
